## Glyphling 0.6.0

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.6.0.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place.

### New
- **First-run tutorial**: seven short steps on the mascot, turning the dial, the panel, going back home, the tray icon and the settings. Settings > Info > "Rivedi il tutorial" shows it again.
- **Two positions**: Settings > Position > "Due posizioni" keeps one place for the circle alone and one for circle + panel. Move the widget while it is closed or open to set each one; it glides between them when the panel opens or closes.
- **Flat dial**: no more 3D shadow and press effect on the ring.

### Also in 0.5.3
- No black rectangle behind the widget or black corners on Settings, dial drag works again, the shape stays on screen when the panel side flips, and the setup lets you choose the install folder.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
